// Prints TypeScript's `osq status` output for each golden of rust-show "Status
// text equals TypeScript's".
// Run from the repository root after `pnpm build`:
//   node print-status-goldens.mjs <fixture show-project> <golden folder>
// Each case runs the built CLI with a fresh scratch root as its working
// directory and HOME set to a fresh empty folder. Every case but `empty`
// copies the fixture and writes 003-running's `.run/running/1.pid`, as
// print-goldens.mjs does. The watch cases write records into the root's watch
// state folder, `<home>/.osq/watch/<sha256 of the root's real path>`; a live
// record names this script's own pid, a dead one the pid 2147483646. In the
// output the state folder is replaced by `<state>`, the script's pid by
// `<pid>` and the scratch root by `<root>`. The git case runs `git init -b
// main` in the root with author and committer `osq <osq@example.com>`, writes
// `osq.config.ts` with `vcs: { enabled: true, author: "osq <osq@example.com>" }`
// (the Rust test writes `osq.toml` with the same two keys under `[vcs]`),
// commits everything but 002-approved and 010-archived on `main`, and adds the
// worktrees `<root>-wt` on `osq/002-approved` and `<root>-wt2` on
// `osq/010-archived`, each holding only its own change folder beyond `main`;
// 002-approved's worktree copy gets `.run/running/2.pid` after its commit.
// stdout is written to <name>.txt.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

const BIN = path.resolve('dist', 'cli', 'bin.js');
const [fixture, golden] = process.argv.slice(2);
const DEAD_PID = 2147483646;
const GIT_ENV = {
  GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: 'osq',
  GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: 'osq@example.com',
  GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: 'osq',
  GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: 'osq@example.com',
};
const APPROVED = path.join('openspec', 'changes', '002-approved');
const ARCHIVED = path.join('openspec', 'changes', 'archive', '010-archived');

function write(file, text) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, text);
}

function append(file, text) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.appendFileSync(file, text);
}

function git(cwd, ...args) {
  const run = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', env: { ...process.env, ...GIT_ENV } });
  if (run.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: ${run.stderr}`);
}

function stateDir(root, home) {
  const hash = createHash('sha256').update(fs.realpathSync(root), 'utf8').digest('hex');
  return path.join(home, '.osq', 'watch', hash);
}

function project(root) {
  fs.cpSync(fixture, root, { recursive: true });
  write(
    path.join(root, 'openspec', 'changes', '003-running', '.run', 'running', '1.pid'),
    '{"pid":4242,"startedAt":1759395600000}\n',
  );
}

function watcher(pid, mode, waiting) {
  return `${JSON.stringify({ pid, mode, version: '0.3.0', commit: 'abc1234', startedAt: '2026-10-24T08:00:00.000Z', waiting })}\n`;
}

function service(state) {
  return `${JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, startedAt: '2026-10-24T08:00:00.000Z', log: path.join(state, 'watch.log') })}\n`;
}

const cases = [
  { name: 'status-project', setup: (root) => project(root) },
  { name: 'status-empty', setup: () => {} },
  {
    name: 'status-watch-terminal',
    setup: (root, state) => {
      project(root);
      write(path.join(state, 'watcher.json'), watcher(process.pid, 'terminal', null));
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'status-watch-background',
    setup: (root, state) => {
      project(root);
      write(path.join(state, 'service.json'), service(state));
      write(
        path.join(state, 'watcher.json'),
        watcher(process.pid, 'background', 'usage limit until 2026-10-24T10:00:00.000Z'),
      );
      write(path.join(state, 'watch.log'), 'started\n');
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'status-watch-restarting',
    setup: (root, state) => {
      project(root);
      write(path.join(state, 'service.json'), service(state));
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'status-watch-dead',
    setup: (root, state) => {
      project(root);
      write(path.join(state, 'watcher.json'), watcher(DEAD_PID, 'terminal', null));
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'status-pending',
    setup: (root, state) => {
      project(root);
      write(
        path.join(state, 'after-land.json'),
        '{"change":"010-archived","command":"pnpm build","exitCode":1,"failedAt":"2026-10-24T09:00:00.000Z"}\n',
      );
      append(
        path.join(root, ARCHIVED, '.run', 'events', 'change.jsonl'),
        '{"type":"validator_ran","timestamp":"2026-10-24T09:30:00.000Z","data":{"outcome":"failed","harness":"claude","model":"m","duration":1,"exitCode":null,"scenarios":1,"findings":[],"restored":[],"output":"boom"}}\n',
      );
      write(
        path.join(root, 'openspec', '.run', 'autopilot-stop.md'),
        '---\nreason: land_stopped\nitem: alpha-item\nchange: "010"\ncommand: osq land 010\nat: 2026-10-24T09:45:00.000Z\n---\nland failed\n',
      );
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'status-git',
    setup: (root) => {
      project(root);
      write(
        path.join(root, 'osq.config.ts'),
        'export default { vcs: { enabled: true, author: "osq <osq@example.com>" } };\n',
      );
      const keep = `${root}-keep`;
      fs.mkdirSync(keep);
      fs.renameSync(path.join(root, APPROVED), path.join(keep, 'approved'));
      fs.renameSync(path.join(root, ARCHIVED), path.join(keep, 'archived'));
      git(root, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main');
      git(root, 'add', '-A');
      git(root, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'all');
      const wt = `${root}-wt`;
      git(root, 'worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', 'osq/002-approved', wt);
      fs.cpSync(path.join(keep, 'approved'), path.join(wt, APPROVED), { recursive: true });
      append(
        path.join(wt, APPROVED, '.run', 'events', 'change.jsonl'),
        '{"type":"synced","timestamp":"2026-10-24T08:00:00.000Z","data":{"defaultBranch":"main","commits":2}}\n' +
          '{"type":"sync_stopped","timestamp":"2026-10-24T09:00:00.000Z","data":{"reason":"conflict","message":"src/alpha.ts conflicts\\nsecond line"}}\n',
      );
      git(wt, 'add', '-A');
      git(wt, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'approve 002');
      write(path.join(wt, APPROVED, '.run', 'running', '2.pid'), '{"pid":4242,"startedAt":1759395600000}\n');
      const wt2 = `${root}-wt2`;
      git(root, 'worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', 'osq/010-archived', wt2);
      fs.cpSync(path.join(keep, 'archived'), path.join(wt2, ARCHIVED), { recursive: true });
      git(wt2, 'add', '-A');
      git(wt2, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'archive 010');
    },
  },
];

for (const c of cases) {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'osq-status-'));
  const home = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'osq-status-home-'));
  const state = stateDir(root, home);
  c.setup(root, state);
  const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, [BIN, 'status'], {
    cwd: root,
    encoding: 'utf8',
    env: { ...process.env, HOME: home, NO_COLOR: '1' },
  });
  if (run.status !== 0) throw new Error(`${c.name}: exit ${run.status}\n${run.stderr}`);
  const text = run.stdout
    .split(state)
    .join('<state>')
    .split(root)
    .join('<root>')
    .split(String(process.pid))
    .join('<pid>');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, `${c.name}.txt`), text);
}
